threatProtection.description: Microsoft Defender for open-source databases on the server (billed per server). Default: off in the trial profile, on otherwise.

databases.description: Databases to create on the server (UTF-8), e.g. for the platform's own use. Default: none. Apps get theirs with the AppDatabase API (self-service).

maintenanceWindow.description: When Azure may patch the server. Default: Sunday 02:00 UTC.
